title: Great Pyramid sulfuric acid and central pyramid hydrochloric acid from salt

tellings.quote: So the great pyramid was producing sulfuric acid. That sulfuric acid was utilized inside of the central pyramid reacted with salt to create hydrochloric acid.

plain: The Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt was a chemical plant that made sulfuric acid, a strong acid. That is the claim of a researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, who says the purpose of the pyramids was given to him by an alien. In his telling, the acid was carried into the middle pyramid of the three, where it reacted with salt to make hydrochloric acid, another strong acid. He gives no outside source.
